name: jev-decisions
description: Calibrated judgment tools for ZCode agents via the community jev-mcp server: verify claims against evidence, screen untrusted text, classify, decide, and gate task completion. Ships a skill that teaches when to reach for a judgment tool instead of answering directly.

description_i18n.en: Calibrated judgment tools for ZCode agents via the community jev-mcp server: verify claims against evidence, screen untrusted text, classify, decide, and gate task completion. Ships a skill that teaches when to reach for a judgment tool instead of answering directly.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 通过社区版 jev-mcp 服务为 ZCode 智能体提供校准判断工具：对照证据核实结论、筛查不可信文本、批量分类、多候选择优、任务完成门禁。内置一个 Skill，教会智能体何时应调用判断工具而不是直接凭阅读作答。

typesafeApiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafeApiKey.description: API key for the TypeSafe Jev service used by the bundled jev-mcp server. Required only when the jev MCP server is enabled.
